# Using Video Editor in OpenCode

<!-- Generated by `node packages/cli build` from the harness registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The skill is the same in every agent. This guide covers only what is specific to OpenCode.

## Install

Project scope (one repository): copy this skill folder to `.opencode/skills/video-editor/`.

User scope (every project): copy it to `~/.config/opencode/skills/video-editor/`.

From the gti-skills repository, the CLI does the copy for you:

```bash
node packages/cli install --harness opencode --skill video-editor
node packages/cli install --harness opencode --skill video-editor --scope user
```

Restart the agent session after installing so it rescans its skills.

## Use

Describe the task in plain language. OpenCode loads the skill when the request matches its `description`. You can also name it in the request, for example: "Use the video-editor skill to ...".

## Where the skill finds its files

`<skill-dir>` in `SKILL.md` is the folder that contains `SKILL.md`: `.opencode/skills/video-editor` for a project install, or `~/.config/opencode/skills/video-editor` for a user install. Scripts and references are always addressed relative to it.

## Verify

Ask the agent which skills it has loaded and check that `video-editor` is listed.

## Notes

- OpenCode also reads .claude/skills and .agents/skills.
- This skill drives the packages/videoeditor engine. Build it once with `npm run build` there, and set VIDEOEDITOR_HOME to its folder if you copied the skill folder by hand instead of using the install command. The review server binds to 127.0.0.1 by default; exposing it on the LAN or Tailscale requires an explicit --bind 0.0.0.0.
- Every edit tool prints a `checks` array. Run `review --out <file>` for a static HTML report that needs no server.
- Documentation: [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/) (path source: official).
